newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Low offers in Nepal May diesel, kerosene tenders.
newsitem.headline: Low offers in Nepal May diesel, kerosene tenders.

text.p: The best offers in state-owned Nepal Oil Corp's (NOC) tender to buy 30,000 tonnes each of diesel and kerosene was made by Swiss trader Glencore and Japan's Mitsubishi Corp respectively, traders said on Wednesday.
The 1.0-percent sulphur diesel cargo was offered at $194 per tonne for May 1-10 delivery, cost-and-freight (c-and-f) on a two-port discharge basis to India's east coast.
The superior kerosene cargo was offered at $204 per tonne for the same delivery period, c-and-f east coast.
The tender will be decided by NOC's evaluation committee this evening, an NOC source said.

In its last tender, NOC bought diesel from German trader Mabanaft at $202.75 per tonne for March 11-20, c-and-f basis, and two kerosene cargoes from Dutch trader Vitol at $235-$240 per tonne for March 1-10 and 21-31 deliveries, c-and-f.
